provenance.capture: Official-site Playwright Chromium full-page capture at the recorded viewports. Scrolled in 80 percent viewport increments to trigger lazy content, waited, and returned to top. No page content or styling was altered.
provenance.diagnostics: Observed centered identity navigation, cinematic salon opening, long studio and values statement, single outlined booking action, booking queries. The mobile capture was taken at 390 px. Source-specific omissions and non-transferable claims are noted in the prompt.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A centered black wordmark and spare utility icons sit over one tall salon-film frame; no loud sales headline competes with the space. Tiny salon and store routes beneath the centered mark, with social and shopping symbols at the extreme edges. Minimal all-caps sans labels, long centered body copy and large intervals of white space. The page sequence runs from centered identity navigation to cinematic salon opening to long studio and values statement toward booking queries, two-location information, spare footer. One broad cinematic salon frame dominates; text and contact details below use almost no additional imagery. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.
